field_signals.facts: Minprirody position: if DVOS not submitted or contains unreliable information and new ORO not stated, apply PP 881 paragraph 32 and Ksl=25. For II-category object Mslj is difference between actual waste mass and mass in DVOS. Letter expressly non-normative. It refers to 21.08.2026 №12-77/36444.
field_signals.case_link: Existing DVOS defense case: II-category; DVOS submitted 27.02.2024; 55 t stated; around 50 t actual 2025; changed ORO. Do not infer zero Mslj without examining PP 881 and site-specific calculation.
required_checks: Obtain and compare full text of Minprirody 21.08.2026 №12-77/36444
Verify 2025 effective wording of PP 881 paragraphs 9,20,32 and Federal Law 7-FZ article 31.2
Determine if changed ORO without new DVOS meets legal definition of unreliable information
Calculate Mslj under applicable formula, distinguish total waste mass from mass per ORO
Check evidence new ORO in GRORO, contract, movement records, payment and RPN demand
